claim_scope: Bounded canonical input admission to the existing V2 custody coordinator. The Python nodes replay ten retained economic outputs and one actual global custody/claimant consumer. Rust sources and tests are pinned subjects; Cargo replay is a separate gate. No receipt, cryptographic authentication, store or publication authority is established.
failure_modes: Malformed, noncanonical, foreign-schema, duplicate-field or wrong-command-shape bytes reach an economic transition.
Depth, huge integer or lone-surrogate parser faults escape the public typed codec error contract.
An oversized collection is constructed before its existing row ceiling is enforced.
A new input envelope excludes otherwise admitted states by combining the independent 1MiB limits.
A valid unknown command is reclassified from the existing typed economic no-op into a parse failure.
An economic transition fault is swallowed and reported as a decode failure.
Input decoding changes exact custody effects, canonical roots, dormant identities or global claimant preservation.

aaa.reason: Tests prepare canonical golden inputs or one explicit malformed boundary, invoke the public codec or bytes transition, then check complete outcomes, exact bytes, typed refusal or no transition call.

reject_is_noop.reason: Malformed inputs cannot call the economic transition. Unknown commands preserve empty effects and identical pre/post roots. Successful decoding creates only the existing NONE/SHADOW result. Transition faults retain their original exception identity.

boundary_dimensions.name: outcome_and_precedence
points: no economic callback on parse failure

mutations.description: Restore the reproduced public parser bug: a lone surrogate leaks TypeError rather than the promised GlobalSettlementCodecErrorV2. The retained test failed on the original source before repair.

nonclaims: Packet validation is structural. Its runner executes the declared Python nodes; it does not run Cargo, Lean, Kani, ESSO or a RISC0 guest.
Golden replay covers the ten retained cases and does not establish universal Python/Rust parser or runtime equivalence. Parse-error messages are not a cross-language wire contract.
The surrogate defect was observed failing before its repair. The declared source mutant is not executed merely by validating this packet.

Historical leaf codecs and V1 receipt consumers remain unchanged. No accepted-result decoder, signed-intent authentication, measured image, receipt admission, publication, migration, release or full V3 completion is claimed.
